name: Rate Limit
description: Token-bucket rate limit per account, client IP or platform. Requests over the limit are rejected with HTTP 429.
author: Resin examples

config_fields.name: key
config_fields.label: Limit by
config_fields.description: account_or_ip limits by account when present, otherwise by client IP. Requests without an account are not limited when key is account.

config_fields.name: burst
config_fields.label: Burst
config_fields.description: Maximum number of requests allowed at once.

config_fields.name: platforms
config_fields.label: Platforms
config_fields.description: Only limit these platforms. Empty means every platform.
